data.title: 暗房红灯下的底片显影

data.animaCaption: Seen through a row of wet film negatives hanging in the foreground, she lifts a freshly developed strip with metal tweezers to study it behind thin gold-rimmed glasses. The lone crimson darkroom safelight carves sharp red highlights along her lab coat, vest, and focused gaze.
data.promptProse: Composed through a line of damp photographic film strips clipped to a wire in the near foreground, Ayachi Nene works inside a cramped underground darkroom. Dressed in an unbuttoned white lab coat over a fitted charcoal waistcoat, rolled-sleeve dress shirt, black tie, and thin gold-rimmed glasses, she holds a translucent negative up with steel tweezers, squinting intently at the emerging evidence. A single overhead crimson safelight bathes the dark room in deep ruby highlights and stark black shadows, gleaming off the wet emulsion, glass developer trays, and the silver frames of her glasses.
data.story: 暗房里只剩一盏低悬的红光安全灯。平日总是温声细语的宁宁戴上细框眼镜，用金属镊子把刚显影的微缩底片举到灯前，神情冷静得判若两人——「门锁好了吗？第三格拍到交易名单了……我们只有二十分钟把备份送出去。」
